limitations.note: The rewrite matches the corrected default waveform but replaces the original pulse-width rule for nondefault parameters: a 20-cycle period now stays high for 10 ticks instead of 7.
The default waveform check could catch the original bug, but the nondefault check encoded the rewrite’s half-period assumption and therefore passed despite the pulse-width regression.
The test command had to be resubmitted twice for reasons unrelated to the RTL: first because its cleanup command was rejected, then because it invoked `python` instead of the available `python3`.
